conditions: Icon Composer usually makes a custom imported background image unnecessary.
For iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS icons, Icon Composer supports solid colors and gradients, usually making a custom imported background image unnecessary.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Keep the general background recommendation cross-platform, but scope the Icon Composer workflow to the four platforms explicitly named in Layer design.

Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The recommendation explicitly concerns importing into Icon Composer, which this page scopes to iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS; tvOS and visionOS use Xcode image stacks instead.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Centering to accommodate system-defined platform masks is platform guidance, including the circular visionOS/watchOS case.

conditions: Icon text doesn't support accessibility or localization and can be unreadable, cluttered, or redundant.
Icon text does not support accessibility or localization and can be unreadable, cluttered, or redundant with an app name shown nearby.
A mnemonic such as the first letter of the app name can help recognition; this does not require adding text to every icon.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Prioritize the explicit accessibility and legibility rationale and preserve the optional mnemonic example without inventing an exception to essential text.

conditions: Apple hardware product designs are copyrighted.
The Apple guidance cites copyright and states that Apple hardware products cannot be reproduced in app icons.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Retain the prior explicitly reviewed AVOID mapping for the direct Don’t instruction while recording the full source-stated copyright rationale at legal priority; this is not an independent legal determination.

statement.en: Create app-icon layer groups when effects need to apply to multiple layers together.
statement.ja: 複数layerへまとめてeffectを適用する場合はapp icon layer groupを作る。

conditions: Use grouping only when it fits the design; Icon Composer adds group-level Liquid Glass controls.

statement.en: Group app-icon layers when it makes sense to apply effects to them together.
statement.ja: 複数のアプリアイコンレイヤーへ効果をまとめて適用することがデザインに適している場合は、レイヤーをグループ化する。

conditions: Layers can be grouped in Icon Composer or a design tool when grouping fits the design.
For iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS icons, Icon Composer offers group-level Liquid Glass customization.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Retain if-it-makes-sense rather than requiring a strict need, include the design-tool alternative, and scope only the Composer-specific options to its four platforms.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The page scopes default/dark/clear/tinted appearance choices to iOS, iPadOS, and macOS; the specification table lists N/A for the other platforms.

conditions: Keep every variant visible, legible, and recognizable; darker and tinted contexts are more subdued.
Keep every variant visible, legible, and recognizable; dark icons are subdued, and clear and tinted icons are more subdued still.
The default color palette can be retained.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Use the appearance-specific platforms, prioritize legibility, and preserve the relative subduedness and optional retention of the default palette.

conditions: People choose alternate icons in app settings; every alternate and appearance variant remains subject to app review.
People choose alternate icons in app settings; every alternate and appearance variant remains subject to app review.

Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Separating the icon from the display background protects visual discernibility and belongs to accessibility priority.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: State the optional supported color space consistently with MAY; retain the documented platform restriction and other color-space alternatives.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Retain varying opacity as cross-platform design guidance while limiting the supplementary Composer workflow to its named platforms.

statement.en: Design an app-icon background that stands out and emphasizes foreground content.
statement.ja: 目立ちながらforeground contentを強調するapp icon backgroundを設計する。

conditions: Icon Composer usually makes a custom imported background image unnecessary.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0002.review_note: Separated both explicit conditional background requirements from the general design recommendation.

statement.en: Prefer vector graphics for layers imported into Icon Composer.
statement.ja: Icon Composerへimportするlayerにはvector graphicを優先する。

conditions: Vector SVG or PDF artwork scales cleanly across icon sizes.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0003.review_note: Preserved Prefer at SHOULD and split outline preparation and PNG fallback.

statement.en: Keep primary app-icon content centered so system masking doesn't truncate it.
statement.ja: system maskingで切れないようprimary app icon contentを中央に保つ。

conditions: Pay particular attention to visionOS and watchOS circular icons; use Apple production-template grids for placement.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0004.review_note: Recorded masking and the two circular-platform contexts.

statement.en: Include app-icon text only when it is essential to the experience or brand.
statement.ja: experienceまたはbrandに不可欠な場合だけapp iconにtextを含める。

conditions: Icon text doesn't support accessibility or localization and can be unreadable, cluttered, or redundant.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0007.review_note: Recorded the accessibility, localization, size, and redundancy limits and split two atomic text rules.

statement.en: Avoid replicas of Apple hardware products in app icons.
statement.ja: app iconでApple hardware productのreplicaを避ける。

conditions: Apple hardware product designs are copyrighted.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0009.review_note: Kept the direct Don't guidance at AVOID because it isn't an explicit Never or must-not prohibition.

statement.en: Create app-icon layer groups when effects need to apply to multiple layers together.
statement.ja: 複数layerへまとめてeffectを適用する場合はapp icon layer groupを作る。

conditions: Use grouping only when it fits the design; Icon Composer adds group-level Liquid Glass controls.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0011.review_note: Made the design-fit condition explicit without requiring grouping for every icon.

statement.en: Keep an app icon's core visual features consistent across appearance variants.
statement.ja: appearance variant間でapp iconのcore visual featureを一貫させる。

conditions: Apply across default, dark, clear, and tinted appearances.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0012.review_note: Recorded the full appearance set and split the element-swapping anti-pattern.

statement.en: Design dark, clear, and tinted icons to fit beside system app icons and widgets.
statement.ja: system app iconやwidgetに馴染むdark、clear、tinted iconを設計する。

conditions: Keep every variant visible, legible, and recognizable; darker and tinted contexts are more subdued.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0013.review_note: Expanded the appearance context and recorded visibility, legibility, and recognition outcomes.

statement.en: Use the light app icon as the basis for the dark icon.
statement.ja: light app iconをdark iconの基礎に使う。

conditions: Choose complementary colors that reflect the default design; color backgrounds generally provide strong contrast.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0014.review_note: Recorded the color relationship and split the excessive-brightness anti-pattern.

statement.en: Consider offering alternate app icons on supported platforms.
statement.ja: support対象platformでalternate app iconの提供を検討する。

conditions: People choose alternate icons in app settings; every alternate and appearance variant remains subject to app review.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0015.review_note: Preserved Consider as MAY, narrowed platform availability, and split identity requirements.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0017.title: Avoid concave shapes in a visionOS app-icon background

statement.en: Avoid shapes intended to look concave or hollow in a visionOS app-icon background.
statement.ja: visionOS app-icon backgroundでconcaveまたはhollowに見せるshapeを避ける。

conditions: System shadows and specular highlights can make the shape protrude instead of recede.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0017.review_note: Recorded the system-effect reversal that makes concave background shapes misleading.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0018.title: Avoid a black watchOS app-icon background

statement.en: Avoid using black for a watchOS app-icon background.
statement.ja: watchOS app-icon backgroundにblackを使わない。

conditions: Lighten a black background so the icon doesn't blend into the display background.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0018.review_note: Recorded the display-background blending risk and lightening mitigation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0019.title: Use Display P3 app-icon color only on supported platforms

statement.en: Use Display P3 app-icon color only on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS.
statement.ja: Display P3 app icon colorはiOS、iPadOS、macOS、tvOS、watchOSだけで使う。

conditions: App icons also support sRGB color and Gray Gamma 2.2 grayscale; Display P3 isn't listed for visionOS.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0019.review_note: Reclassified the supported color-space capability from generated SHOULD to MAY and preserved its platform exclusion.

statement.en: Use varying opacity in foreground layers to increase app-icon depth and liveliness.
statement.ja: foreground layerのopacityを変えてapp iconのdepthとlivelinessを高める。

conditions: Importing opaque layers and adjusting transparency in Icon Composer supports preview and iteration.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0020.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Vary lead and recorded the recommended workflow.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0022.title: Ensure imported app-icon backgrounds are full-bleed and opaque

statement.en: When importing an app-icon background layer, ensure it is full-bleed and opaque.
statement.ja: app icon background layerをimportする場合はfull-bleedかつopaqueにする。

conditions: Icon Composer solid colors and gradients usually avoid the need for an imported background.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0022.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure requirement and preserved the no-import default.

statement.en: Outline app-icon artwork and convert icon text to outlines before import.
statement.ja: import前にapp icon artworkをoutline化し、icon textをoutlineへ変換する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0023.review_note: Recovered the vector-preparation action as a separate rule.

statement.en: Prefer PNG for app-icon mesh gradients and raster artwork.
statement.ja: app iconのmesh gradientとraster artworkにはPNGを優先する。

conditions: PNG is a lossless fallback when vector graphics aren't appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0024.review_note: Recovered the documented raster fallback and retained Prefer at SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0025.title: Create unmasked app-icon layers in the platform layout shape

statement.en: Create unmasked app-icon layers in the layout shape required by the target platform.
statement.ja: target platformが求めるlayout shapeでmaskなしのapp icon layerを作る。

conditions: Use square layers for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and watchOS; use rectangular layers for tvOS.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0025.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Produce lead and recorded every platform shape mapping.

statement.en: Avoid applying predefined masking to app-icon layers.
statement.ja: app icon layerにpredefined maskingを適用しない。

conditions: Premasking harms specular highlights and can produce jagged edges after system masking.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0026.review_note: Recovered the masking anti-pattern as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0027.title: Use a simple, recognizable app-icon design

statement.en: Use a simple, recognizable app-icon design with a minimal number of shapes.
statement.ja: 最小限のshapeでsimpleかつrecognizableなapp icon designを作る。

conditions: Center one concept that captures the app or game; prefer a simple background that emphasizes it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0027.review_note: Recovered the previously omitted simplicity lead and recorded its concept, detail, and background criteria.

statement.en: Avoid nonessential action words and context-specific terms in app icons.
statement.ja: app iconでnonessentialなaction wordやcontext-specific termを避ける。

conditions: Examples include “Watch,” “Play,” “New,” and “For visionOS.”
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0028.review_note: Recovered the text anti-pattern as AVOID while preserving essential brand text.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0029.title: Keep tvOS app-icon text above other layers

statement.en: When a tvOS app icon includes text, ensure it appears above the other layers.
statement.ja: tvOS app iconにtextを含める場合は他のlayerより上に配置する。

conditions: Keep text above parallax layers so the system doesn't crop it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0029.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure tvOS text-layer requirement.

statement.en: Avoid replicating standard UI components or app screenshots in an app icon.
statement.ja: app iconでstandard UI componentやapp screenshotを複製しない。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0030.review_note: Split the direct UI-replication anti-pattern from the illustration preference.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0031.title: Ensure app-icon artwork avoids fragile lines and corners

statement.en: Ensure app-icon artwork avoids extremely thin lines and sharp corners.
statement.ja: app icon artworkで極端に細いlineやsharp cornerを避ける。

conditions: Thin lines and sharp corners lose detail and crispness at small sizes and low resolutions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0031.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure to avoid requirement as a positive MUST outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0032.title: Ensure custom app-icon effects don't conflict with system effects

statement.en: When using custom app-icon effects, ensure they appear as expected and don't conflict with system effects.
statement.ja: custom app icon effectを使う場合は意図どおり表示されsystem effectと競合しないようにする。

conditions: Test intentionally in Icon Composer, Device Hub, or on a physical device.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0032.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure verification outcome without requiring custom effects.

statement.en: Avoid swapping app-icon elements between appearance variants.
statement.ja: appearance variant間でapp icon elementを入れ替えない。

conditions: Element swaps can make the app harder to find after people change appearances.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0033.review_note: Recovered the variant-swapping anti-pattern as AVOID.

statement.en: Avoid excessively bright images in dark app icons.
statement.ja: dark app iconで過度にbrightなimageを避ける。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0034.review_note: Recovered the direct dark-appearance anti-pattern as AVOID.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0035.title: Keep alternate app icons related to the app experience

statement.en: When offering alternate app icons, ensure each remains closely related to the app's content and experience.
statement.ja: alternate app iconを提供する場合、各iconをapp contentとexperienceに密接に関連させる。

conditions: The app offers alternate icons on a supported platform.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0035.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure identity requirement and narrowed supported platforms.

statement.en: Avoid alternate app icons that people might mistake for another app.
statement.ja: 別のappと誤認される可能性があるalternate app iconを避ける。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0036.review_note: Recovered the identity-confusion anti-pattern as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0037.title: Create 1024×1024 layered app-icon layouts for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS

statement.en: Create square 1024×1024 px layered app-icon layouts for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
statement.ja: iOS、iPadOS、macOS向けにsquareの1024×1024 px layered app icon layoutを作る。

conditions: The system masks the square layout to a rounded rectangle and supports default, dark, clear, and tinted appearances.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0037.review_note: Recovered the complete iOS, iPadOS, and macOS specification row as SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0038.title: Create an 800×480 layered parallax app-icon layout for tvOS

statement.en: Create a rectangular 800×480 px layered parallax app-icon layout for tvOS.
statement.ja: tvOS向けにrectangularの800×480 px layered parallax app icon layoutを作る。

conditions: The system masks the landscape layout to a rounded rectangle.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0038.review_note: Recovered the complete tvOS specification row as SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0039.title: Create a 1024×1024 layered 3D app-icon layout for visionOS

statement.en: Create a square 1024×1024 px layered 3D app-icon layout for visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOS向けにsquareの1024×1024 px layered 3D app icon layoutを作る。

conditions: The system masks the square layout to a circle.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0039.review_note: Recovered the complete visionOS specification row as SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0040.title: Create a 1088×1088 layered app-icon layout for watchOS

statement.en: Create a square 1088×1088 px layered app-icon layout for watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOS向けにsquareの1088×1088 px layered app icon layoutを作る。

conditions: The system masks the square layout to a circle.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0040.review_note: Recovered the complete watchOS specification row as SHOULD.

prior_batch_metadata.review_note: Completed common App icons coverage; retained sixteen existing IDs, recovered twenty-one atomic rules including four platform specification rows, retained six explicit conditional Ensure or Make sure outcomes as MUST, kept direct Don't and Avoid guidance below MUST_NOT, and reclassified Display P3 support as MAY.

Root rechecked helper corrections and the complete specification mappings. Verified all six conditional/explicit MUST outcomes. Narrowed tool/appearance scope only where the page names platforms; kept optional workflows and source-stated constraints separate. Four synthesized prior hashes were explicitly migrated to the current DOM specification table, preserving candidate paraphrases and stable IDs with duplicate-key aliases. Exact trace presence and semantic approval are separate checks.

The hardware-replica rule retains the prior explicit AVOID classification; its copyright rationale is Apple’s source statement, not independent legal advice.

extraction_verification.method: Isolated extraction; all canonical rule files and stable-ID registry matched byte-for-byte.
